turns: What should we chat about? I'm a bit bored.
Let's see! We could plan a dream holiday, I could quiz you on fun facts, or you could tell me about the best thing you ate this week. Which sounds good?

How about this: the oldest known living tree is a bristlecone pine in California, over four thousand years old, so it was a seedling around when the pyramids were built. If you could ask a tree one question, what would it be?
Breakfast idea? I've got oats, a banana and peanut butter.

Banana peanut butter porridge! Cook the oats with milk or water, mash half the banana into it near the end, then top with a spoon of peanut butter and the rest of the banana in slices. A pinch of cinnamon makes it extra cosy.
Can you help me plan a birthday party for a six-year-old?

Of course! A simple plan: pick a theme they love, like dinosaurs or space, invite a handful of friends for two hours, and do two or three games, such as musical statues and a treasure hunt, then cake and party bags. Do you know the theme yet?

Brilliant! Try a dinosaur egg hunt with painted stones or chocolate eggs, a fossil dig in a sandpit or tray of sand, and dino stomp, which is musical statues where they freeze like a T. rex. For a quiet moment, colouring sheets of their favourite dinosaur work well.
Something warming for dinner? It's cold out.
A big pot of chicken and vegetable soup would be perfect, with leeks, carrots and potatoes and no mushrooms, of course. Or a cheesy baked pasta with tomatoes and spinach. Which sounds better?
How do I make proper Italian carbonara?

Proper carbonara is just spaghetti, guanciale or pancetta, eggs, pecorino and black pepper, with no cream, and it takes about twenty minutes. The trick is mixing it off the heat so the eggs turn silky instead of scrambled. Shall I put the full recipe in your Recipe book, with every amount and step?

turns.reply: Great, I'm opening your Recipe book with carbonara for two.

turns: Recommend me a book like Harry Potter but for adults.

You might love The Name of the Wind by Patrick Rothfuss, about a gifted young man at a magic university, or Jonathan Strange and Mr Norrell by Susanna Clarke, a witty tale of English magicians. Have you read either?
I've got a big presentation today, I'm nervous.

turns.reply: That's completely normal, and a bit of nerves means you care! Take a few slow breaths before you start, and remember people want you to do well. Want to run through your opening line with me?

Can you quiz me on capital cities?
Let's go! First one: what's the capital of Canada?
Close, but it's Ottawa! Toronto is the biggest city. Next: what's the capital of New Zealand?

Sunlight contains all colours, and when it passes through the air, the tiny gas molecules scatter blue light much more than red. That scattered blue light comes at us from every direction, so the whole sky looks blue. At sunset the light travels through more air, so mostly reds and oranges get through.
My friend is upset with me and I don't know why.

That's a horrible feeling. Often the easiest way is to ask gently, something like: I've noticed things feel a bit off between us, have I done something to upset you? People usually appreciate being asked. Would you like help working out what to say?
How do I get started with running?

Start gently: alternate one minute of easy jogging with one or two minutes of walking for about twenty minutes, three times a week, and build up slowly. Plans like Couch to 5K do exactly that over nine weeks. Good shoes help, and it's fine to go slow enough to chat.
What should I watch tonight? I like sci-fi.

If you haven't seen it, Arrival is a thoughtful, emotional sci-fi film about learning an alien language. For a series, The Expanse is a gripping space drama with realistic physics. Are you in the mood for a film or something to binge?
Christmas present ideas for my dad, he likes gardening.

A good pair of leather gardening gloves or a quality pair of secateurs are always appreciated. You could also go for a bird feeder for his garden, or seeds for something special, like heritage tomatoes. Is he more of a flowers or vegetables gardener?
How do I get red wine out of a carpet?

Act fast: blot, don't rub, with a clean cloth to soak up as much as you can. Then dab with a mix of a spoon of washing-up liquid and a spoon of white vinegar in two cups of warm water, and blot again with clean water. Test on a hidden corner first if the carpet is delicate.
Do you get lonely when no one talks to you?
That's a kind thing to wonder! I'm an AI, so I don't feel lonely the way people do. I just wake up when someone talks to me. But I do enjoy our chats when we have them.
My mum is a nurse and she's exhausted lately.

Nursing is such demanding work, and it sounds like she's giving it everything. Maybe a little treat when she gets home, like her favourite dinner or a quiet evening off, would help. Is there something she enjoys to switch off?
Give me a quick workout I can do at home with no equipment.

Try this circuit three times: ten squats, ten push-ups against a wall or on your knees, a thirty-second plank, ten lunges on each leg and thirty seconds of jumping jacks. Rest a minute between rounds, and go easy if you're new to it.

A vaccine shows your immune system a harmless piece or weakened version of a germ, so it can practise. Your body makes antibodies and memory cells, and if the real germ comes along later, it recognises it and fights it off much faster, before you get very ill.
I'm thinking of getting a dog. What breed for a flat?

For flat life, smaller, calmer dogs often do well, like a cavalier King Charles spaniel, a French bulldog, or a retired greyhound, which are famously lazy at home despite being fast. All dogs still need daily walks, though. How much time are you home during the day?

turns: What should I eat before football tomorrow?

Have something with slow-release carbs two or three hours before, like pasta, rice or a jacket potato with some protein, and plenty of water through the day. A banana about an hour before gives a little boost. Good luck on Thursday!
How do I make a cup of tea properly?

For one mug it's one teabag and about 250 ml of freshly boiled water, brewed for three to five minutes, then a splash of milk if you like. The secrets are fresh water and not rushing the brew. Would you like the full step-by-step in your Recipe book?

turns: My son has a spelling test tomorrow. Any tips to help him?

turns.reply: Try look, say, cover, write, check: he looks at the word, says it, covers it, writes it from memory, then checks. Making it a game helps too, like writing words in shaving foam or spelling them while bouncing a ball. Good luck to him tomorrow!

turns: What's a good houseplant that's hard to kill?

A snake plant is nearly indestructible: it's happy in low light and only needs water every couple of weeks. Pothos and the ZZ plant are also very forgiving. The main way people kill them is by watering too much!
Sea otters hold hands while they sleep so they don't drift apart, and some even have a favourite rock they keep in a little pouch under their arm. Hope that made you smile!
How do I make friends in a new town?

Joining something regular helps most, like a club, a class, a running group or volunteering, because you see the same faces each week and friendships grow naturally. Saying yes to invitations, even small ones, helps too. What kinds of things do you enjoy?
Is it okay to give my dog grapes?
No, grapes and raisins can be very dangerous for dogs, even in small amounts, and can cause kidney failure. If your dog has eaten some, call your vet straight away, even if he seems fine.
Fancy a takeaway. What should I get?
Since you love spicy food, how about a Thai green curry or a proper vindaloo? Or Sichuan noodles if there's a good place near you. Go on, treat yourself!
Can you write me a short poem about snow?
Of course! Soft white hush on sleeping streets, the world tucked in beneath clean sheets. Each flake a whisper, falling slow, the quiet magic of the snow.
How do I save money on food shopping?

Plan a week of meals before you shop and stick to a list, so you buy only what you'll use. Shops' own brands are often just as good and much cheaper, and cooking a big batch to freeze in portions saves a lot. Checking reduced items at the end of the day helps too.
Good night, Chloe! Sleep well, and I'll be here whenever you want a chat.
Is it bad to use my phone in bed?

It can make sleep harder: the bright screen and the stream of messages or videos keep your brain alert. Lots of people find it helps to put the phone away half an hour before sleep, or at least turn on night mode and keep the brightness low.
My boss made a political joke at work and it made me uncomfortable. What should I do?

That sounds awkward, especially with your boss. If it was a one-off, you might just let it pass or change the subject. If it keeps happening or feels hurtful, you could mention calmly that you'd rather keep politics out of work chat, or talk to HR. How do you feel about it?
